marketplace.description: Independent, platform-neutral workflow plugins for Codex and Claude Code.

plugins.description: Standards for maintainable code comments, docstrings, TODOs, and public API documentation.

codex.longDescription: Generate, review, and improve comments, docstrings, TODOs, and public API documentation while preserving code behavior and repository style.
defaultPrompt: Use code-comment-standard to review and improve comments in this codebase.

plugins.description: Standards for uv and hatchling pyproject.toml configuration and Python project metadata.

codex.longDescription: Create or review pyproject.toml metadata, dependencies, dynamic versions, licenses, scripts, classifiers, and uv index configuration.
defaultPrompt: Use pyproject-standard when creating or editing pyproject.toml.

plugins.description: Minimal project progress tracking and explicit workflows for README, planning, architecture, guidance, and documentation organization.

codex.longDescription: Track existing tasks with one lightweight automatic skill. Explicitly invoke six focused skills for documentation setup, refactoring, README and usage guides, planning formats and archives, C4 architecture and ADRs, or AGENTS guidance.
defaultPrompt: Use $project-docs:project-docs-bootstrap to initialize a minimal documentation baseline for this repository.
Use $project-docs:project-docs-refactor to audit or reorganize this repository's documentation structure and ownership.
Use $project-docs:project-docs-readme to create or maintain the README, official translations, and task-based usage guide.
Use $project-docs:project-docs-planning to organize TODO, roadmap, milestones, backlog, and plan/spec storage and archiving without rewriting plan/spec content.
Use $project-docs:project-docs-architecture to maintain current or target architecture, Mermaid diagrams, and ADRs.
Use $project-docs:project-docs-guidance to create or refine AGENTS.md, scoped rules, and the CLAUDE.md symlink.
Use $project-docs:project-docs-progress to continue the current task and record only meaningful progress.
